title: PostgreSQL LoopRuntime wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on PG bootstrap config drift. Catches B19/B21 (Bitnami legacy image rename), B27 (per-component DB creation), B29 (primary.initdb.scripts location post chart 18.x) at lint time instead of pod CrashLoopBackOff time.

registry.description: Image registry. Default 'docker.io' for Bitnami chart. Production may override to a private mirror.

repository.description: Image repository. B19/B21: Bitnami migrated free-tier tags to 'bitnamilegacy/*' mid-2025. Pattern anchored to OCI image ref syntax.

tag.description: Optional pin. Default: chart appVersion. Avoid pinning unless verified to exist on registry.

username.description: PG username. Lowercase + underscore (PG identifier convention). Empty/missing = chart picks 'postgres' default = security risk.

password.description: PG password. MUST be set (no auto-generated). Production overrides via Pulumi/SOPS Secret. Empty = chart auto-gens but loses across restarts.

database.description: Initial database name. PG identifier convention (lowercase + underscore).

primary.description: B29 fix (CHG-2026-04-30-INFRA-PARITY): bitnami postgresql 18.x expects 'primary.initdb.scripts', NOT top-level 'initdb.scripts'. Schema validates the correct nesting.

scripts.description: Map of script-name → SQL. B27 requires CREATE DATABASE for gitea/kratos/hydra here.

create.description: Bitnami chart-owned PDB. B2 (cleanroom dogfood 2026-05-05): Tiltfile installs separate PDB; disable bitnami-owned to prevent conflict.

size.description: PVC size — Kubernetes resource quantity (e.g., '10Gi'). Pattern enforces unit suffix to avoid silent parsing failure.
